# IMCMB
> IMCMB provides cryptocurrency exchange, wallet, card, and merchant payment services for individuals and businesses.

IMCMB offers digital asset trading, custodial and non-custodial wallet products, crypto-linked cards, payment processing, and business services. The site includes product pages, legal and compliance information, support resources, and company materials.

## Core Products
- [Exchange](https://imcmdb.net/exchange): Cryptocurrency exchange product for buying, selling, and converting supported digital assets.
- [Wallet](https://imcmdb.net/wallet): Digital wallet product for storing, sending, and receiving cryptocurrencies.
- [Card](https://imcmdb.net/card): Crypto card product for spending digital assets through card-based payments.
- [Merchant](https://imcmdb.net/merchant): Merchant payment solution for accepting cryptocurrency payments in business workflows.
- [Business](https://imcmdb.net/business): Business-focused financial and crypto service offerings for companies and institutional users.
- [Payments](https://imcmdb.net/payments): Payment services overview covering crypto transaction and settlement capabilities.

## Platform Information
- [Home](https://imcmdb.net/): Main entry point with overview of IMCMB products, services, and company positioning.
- [About](https://imcmdb.net/about): Company overview, mission, and background information about the IMCMB platform.
- [Pricing](https://imcmdb.net/pricing): Pricing and fee information for platform products and transaction services.
- [Security](https://imcmdb.net/security): Security practices and protections for accounts, wallets, and platform operations.
- [Features](https://imcmdb.net/features): Summary of platform capabilities across exchange, wallet, and payment products.
- [Partners](https://imcmdb.net/partners): Information about partnerships, integrations, and ecosystem relationships.

## Support
- [Help Center](https://imcmdb.net/help): Central support area for common questions and customer assistance resources.
- [FAQ](https://imcmdb.net/faq): Frequently asked questions about accounts, transactions, and product usage.
- [Contact](https://imcmdb.net/contact): Contact options for reaching support, sales, or general company inquiries.
- [Support](https://imcmdb.net/support): Customer support portal for issue resolution and service assistance.
- [Status](https://imcmdb.net/status): Service availability and operational status information for platform systems.

## Legal and Compliance
- [Terms of Service](https://imcmdb.net/terms): Terms governing use of the IMCMB platform and related services.
- [Privacy Policy](https://imcmdb.net/privacy): Privacy practices covering data collection, use, and protection.
- [Cookie Policy](https://imcmdb.net/cookies): Information about cookie usage and tracking technologies on the site.
- [AML Policy](https://imcmdb.net/aml): Anti-money laundering policy and compliance-related information.
- [KYC Policy](https://imcmdb.net/kyc): Identity verification requirements and know-your-customer policy details.
- [Compliance](https://imcmdb.net/compliance): Overview of regulatory, verification, and compliance commitments.

## Business Services
- [Corporate Accounts](https://imcmdb.net/business/accounts): Business account offering for companies managing crypto and payment operations.
- [Merchant Payments](https://imcmdb.net/merchant/payments): Payment acceptance tools for merchants processing cryptocurrency transactions.
- [Settlement](https://imcmdb.net/business/settlement): Business settlement capabilities for handling incoming and outgoing funds.
- [Invoicing](https://imcmdb.net/business/invoicing): Invoice and billing workflows for business payment collection.
- [Payouts](https://imcmdb.net/business/payouts): Bulk or operational payout services for business disbursement needs.
- [Enterprise Support](https://imcmdb.net/business/support): Support resources tailored to business and enterprise customers.

## Account and Access
- [Sign Up](https://imcmdb.net/signup): Account registration page for creating a new IMCMB user profile.
- [Login](https://imcmdb.net/login): User authentication page for accessing existing accounts and services.
- [Dashboard](https://imcmdb.net/dashboard): Account dashboard for managing balances, activity, and product access.
- [Verification](https://imcmdb.net/verification): Identity verification flow and account validation requirements.
- [Profile](https://imcmdb.net/profile): User profile management for personal details, preferences, and settings.
- [Settings](https://imcmdb.net/settings): Account configuration options for security, notifications, and preferences.

## Developers

- [Sandbox](https://imcmdb.net/sandbox): Test environment for validating integrations without using production funds.
